threadParts:
AG-UI and WebMCP both connect agents to web apps, so it's easy to assume they compete.

They point in opposite directions.

The question I ask: who owns the agent?

• You own it and you're building its UI → AG-UI
• The user brings their own agent → WebMCP

I wrote up the difference, with code for both, and how one tool definition can serve both doors:

https://threadplane.ai/blog/ag-ui-vs-webmcp?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ag-ui-vs-webmcp
